extraction.name: MINT-1T
extraction.description: MINT-1T is an open-source multimodal interleaved dataset comprising one trillion text tokens and 3.4 billion images. It includes diverse data sources such as HTML, PDFs, and ArXiv papers to train large multimodal models.
extraction.creator: Anas Awadalla; Le Xue; Oscar Lo; Manli Shu; Hannah Lee; Etash Guha; Matt Jordan; Sheng Shen; Mohamed Awadalla; Silvio Savarese; Caiming Xiong; Ran Xu; Yejin Choi; Ludwig Schmidt
extraction.citeAs: Anas Awadalla, Le Xue, Oscar Lo, Manli Shu, Hannah Lee, Etash Guha, Matt Jordan, Sheng Shen, Mohamed Awadalla, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, Ran Xu, Yejin Choi, Ludwig Schmidt. Scaling Open-Source Multimodal Data by 10x: A Multimodal Dataset with One Trillion Tokens. arXiv:2406.11271v5, 2024.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Data was obtained from a third-party web crawl, CommonCrawl, for HTML and PDF documents, and directly from ArXiv S3 buckets for ArXiv documents. HTML documents were extracted by parsing WARC entry DOM trees, PDFs were sourced from WAT files, and ArXiv documents were built from LaTeX source code.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Some image links were non-retrievable during collection due to link rot, and the PDF parsing process sometimes failed to detect images or extracted an incorrect reading order.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: CommonCrawl WARC files, CommonCrawl WAT files, and LaTeX source code from ArXiv S3 buckets.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset eliminates non-English documents; the PDF subset has a higher proportion of Science and Technology documents.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: PDF parsing sometimes fails to detect images and extracts incorrect reading orders; should not be used to train models that ingest or generate personally identifying information or for military applications.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset aims to make research into large multimodal models more accessible and enable open science, though releasing large datasets carries the risk of exposing harmful content from the web.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset may contain images of individuals, text about specific individuals, and potentially confidential data from the public web. Email addresses and IP addresses were anonymized to mitigate personal data leakage.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Pre-training large multimodal models that can process multiple interleaved images and text; generating interleaved images and text sequences; building multimodal document retrieval systems.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The authors will maintain the dataset, respond to issues, and communicate updates and errata via the Huggingface README. A form will be provided for opting data out, older versions will be accessible via Git history, and community contributions will be accepted through Pull Requests.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: During training, we randomly drop 50% of single-image interleaved documents to upsample multi-image documents.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Preprocessing includes filtering documents based on image count, discarding large or text-less PDFs, and cleaning LaTeX code by removing imports, bibliographies, tables, and citations. Text is filtered to remove non-English documents, NSFW URLs, and low-quality text. Images are filtered by retrievability, size, and aspect ratio. Safety filtering includes removing documents with NSFW images and anonymizing PII (replacing emails and IPs). Deduplication is performed on paragraphs (using a Bloom filter on 13-grams), documents, and images (using SHA256 hashes).
